{{Quote|Inmate three-four-six-six-seven, descend and receive new instructions.|The security droid, to Migs Mayfeld|<ref name="Chapter 15" />}}
An '''N5 sentry droid''' operated for the [[New Republic]] at<ref name="Chapter 15" /> the [[Karthon Chop Fields]],<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref> a scrapyard where [[prisoner]]s of the New Republic were sentenced to serve.<ref name="Chapter 15" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|15|the [[N5 sentry droid]]'s appearance}}</ref> the [[N5 sentry droid]] approached the prisoner<ref name="Chapter 15" /> [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> as he worked, ordering him to salute in the presence of New Republic [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]]. Dune remanded Mayfeld into her custody, and the [[security droid]] accepted, ordering the prisoner to follow her. Mayfeld was confused by the situation, and the droid repeated its order, threatening him to comply within three [[second]]s. The prisoner relented, following Dune to her [[Slave I|starship]].<ref name="Chapter 15" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The N5 sentry droid appeared in "[[Chapter 15: The Believer]]," the seventh episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 15" /> on [[December 11]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> The droid was portrayed by [[Donald Mills]].<ref name="Chapter 15" />
